event.title: Causing Damage Earthquake
event.summary: Panama experienced a powerful 7.7 magnitude earthquake, followed by a 6.6 magnitude aftershock and several tremors. The quake caused significant damage to buildings, including the collapse of a cathedral, and prompted evacuations across the region. Fortunately, no fatalities have been reported.

timeline.title: Panama Issues State of Emergency Amid Ongoing Aftershocks from Recent Earthquakes
timeline.summary: Panama's government declared a state of emergency following two significant earthquakes, measuring 7.7 and 6.6 in magnitude, that struck the country. The quakes triggered over 100 aftershocks, with the strongest reaching 5.8. While no fatalities have been reported, damage has been noted across all 10 provinces and two Indigenous territories.
key_facts: Two earthquakes of 7.7 and 6.6 magnitude occurred on October 10, 2026.
Over 100 aftershocks were recorded, with the strongest at 5.8 magnitude.
A state of emergency was declared by the Panamanian government.
Damage reported in all 10 provinces and two Indigenous territories.
